shape.derived: Six pieces at two a week is three weeks of programming. That is a run, not a channel, and it is the right size to find out whether the cadence survives contact.

each_piece_carries.quoted: how the script came about… what the inspiration was
each_piece_carries.why: The author asked for this explicitly and it is the unusual requirement. Most production systems store the output and lose the derivation. Here the derivation is a field, so a piece that cannot say where it came from is incomplete rather than merely undocumented.

each_piece_carries.quoted: contained and constrained, but also refined and in alignment
